integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by exhaustive face enumeration and a complete acyclic discrete-Morse matching on the full Hasse diagram; independent signed boundary-rank computations over three finite fields reproduce the asserted homology.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the explicitly specified Frucht graph and its ordinary independence complex.
No family-level statement for cubic, asymmetric, identity, or Halin graphs is asserted.
Literature searches cannot establish absolute bibliographic uniqueness.
title: The Frucht-graph independence complex is a wedge of three 2-spheres
